steps.speaker: Furorian Boy
steps.content: Lady Hypatia... why did you not tell us the truth? Why did you leave us behind?

steps.speaker: Furorian Boy
steps.content: Did you not swear to protect Furor... to protect us?

steps.speaker: Furorian Boy
steps.content: Why did you keep silent about the inheritance buried below us? Are you no different from those high nobles, treating the people of Furor as sacrifices?!
The shadow wails, chasing her a short distance before its form begins to fray. It unravels into a cloud of black dust, scattering like ashes across the chaotic dreamscape.
